To add a VPN: get a WireGuard settings file (.conf) from your VPN provider, open the phone remote from Settings, and send the file from your phone. SCARY comes with no VPN provider.
Only SCARY goes through this VPN; other apps on the TV do not. Your VPN provider sees what your internet provider saw before. Real-Debrid refuses some VPN addresses.
